from_quote: the power of instituting impeachments in one part of the legislative body
rationale: Names, as a "constitutional check," "the power of instituting impeachments in one part of the legislative body," the power of impeachment this clause gives the House of Representatives.

from_quote: constituting the Senate a court for the trial of impeachments
rationale: Names the power "of determining upon" impeachments in the other part of the legislature and "constituting the Senate a court for the trial of impeachments," the trial of impeachments set out in this clause.
to_quote: The Senate shall have the sole Power to try all Impeachments.

from_quote: the power of constituting inferior courts
rationale: Names "the power of constituting inferior courts," and the footnote attached to those words gives "the expressions of the Constitution" as "to constitute tribunals inferior to the supreme court," the words of this clause.
Quotes in quotation marks the opening words of this clause, "to constitute tribunals," in discussing the power of constituting inferior courts. Medium because only two words are quoted.

from_quote: A technical sense has been affixed to the term “appellate,”
rationale: Takes up the objection to "this appellate jurisdiction" as applied to matters of fact, putting this clause's word "appellate" in quotation marks.

from_quote: the Supreme Court shall possess appellate jurisdiction both as to law and FACT, and that this jurisdiction shall be subject to such EXCEPTIONS and regulations as the national legislature may prescribe
rationale: Speaks of "this particular provision" of the convention and restates its words on appellate jurisdiction "both as to law and FACT" subject to "such EXCEPTIONS and regulations."
to_quote: appellate Jurisdiction, both as to Law and Fact, with such Exceptions, and under such Regulations as the Congress shall make

from_quote: the Supreme Court will possess an appellate jurisdiction, both as to law and fact, in all the cases referred to them, both subject to any EXCEPTIONS and REGULATIONS
rationale: Summing up, the paragraph repeats this clause's words "appellate jurisdiction, both as to law and fact" and its "EXCEPTIONS and REGULATIONS" in capitals.
to_quote: appellate Jurisdiction, both as to Law and Fact
